insurancePages.title: Auto Insurance
insurancePages.description: Get comprehensive auto insurance coverage that protects you, your passengers, and your vehicle. From fender benders to major collisions, Dwyer Insurance Group auto insurance has you covered with customizable policies tailored to your needs.
insurancePages.features: ["Liability coverage for bodily injury & property damage","Collision coverage for vehicle damage","Comprehensive coverage for non-collision events","Uninsured/underinsured motorist protection","Medical payments coverage","Roadside assistance add-on","Rental reimbursement coverage"]
insurancePages.tip: Bundle auto with home insurance and save up to 25% on your premium!

insurancePages.title: Home Insurance
insurancePages.tagline: Your home, your haven — we protect both
insurancePages.description: Your home is likely your biggest investment. Dwyer Insurance Group homeowners insurance helps protect your home and belongings against covered losses like fire, theft, and severe weather. Suzanne will help you find the right coverage at the right price.
insurancePages.features: ["Dwelling coverage for your home's structure","Personal property protection","Liability protection if someone is injured on your property","Additional living expenses if your home is unlivable","Other structures coverage (garages, sheds, fences)","Medical payments to others","Claim RateGuard® — your rate won't increase due to a claim"]
insurancePages.tip: Ask about the Claim RateGuard® add-on to keep your rates from increasing after a claim.

insurancePages.title: Life Insurance
insurancePages.description: Life insurance provides financial protection for your loved ones when they need it most. Whether you're looking for term life, whole life, or universal life insurance, Suzanne can help you find a policy that fits your budget and provides peace of mind.
insurancePages.features: ["Term life insurance for affordable, temporary coverage","Whole life insurance with cash value accumulation","Universal life insurance with flexible premiums","Convertible term policies","Death benefit protection for your beneficiaries","Tax-advantaged cash value growth","Estate planning support"]
insurancePages.tip: Term life insurance can be 5-15x more affordable than whole life — perfect for young families!

insurancePages.title: Renters Insurance
insurancePages.tagline: Your landlord's insurance won't cover your stuff
insurancePages.description: Even if you don't own your home, your personal belongings still need protection. Renters insurance covers your possessions against theft, fire, and other covered perils — often for less than you might think.
insurancePages.features: ["Personal property coverage for belongings","Liability protection if someone is injured in your home","Additional living expenses if your rental is damaged","Medical payments to others","Coverage for theft, fire, vandalism, and more","Off-premises theft coverage","Affordable monthly premiums"]
insurancePages.tip: Renters insurance can cost as little as $15-30/month — less than a streaming subscription!

insurancePages.title: Condo Insurance
insurancePages.description: Condo insurance is different from homeowners insurance because your condo association's master policy covers the building's exterior and common areas. Suzanne will help you understand what's covered and fill in the gaps for your unit.
insurancePages.features: ["Coverage for interior walls and fixtures","Personal property protection","Liability coverage","Loss assessment coverage for shared areas","Additional living expenses","Improvements and betterments coverage","Medical payments to others"]
insurancePages.tip: Review your condo association's master policy to understand exactly what you need to cover.

insurancePages.title: Motorcycle Insurance
insurancePages.description: Whether you ride a cruiser, sport bike, touring motorcycle, or scooter, Dwyer Insurance Group motorcycle insurance provides the coverage you need. From liability to comprehensive protection, ride knowing you're covered.
insurancePages.features: ["Liability coverage for bodily injury & property damage","Collision and comprehensive coverage","Uninsured motorist protection","Custom parts and equipment coverage","Roadside assistance for motorcycles","Guest passenger liability","Multiple motorcycle discounts"]
insurancePages.tip: Store your bike in the off-season? Ask about lay-up periods to reduce your premium.

insurancePages.title: Business Insurance
insurancePages.description: From small businesses to larger operations, Suzanne offers a range of commercial insurance solutions. Protect your business property, employees, and bottom line with customized coverage that grows with your business.
insurancePages.features: ["General liability insurance","Commercial property insurance","Business owner's policy (BOP)","Workers' compensation","Commercial auto insurance","Professional liability / Errors & Omissions","Cyber liability coverage"]
insurancePages.tip: A Business Owner's Policy (BOP) bundles property and liability coverage at a reduced rate.

insurancePages.title: Boat Insurance
insurancePages.description: Enjoy the water with peace of mind. Dwyer Insurance Group boat insurance covers your vessel, motor, trailer, and equipment against a wide range of risks, both on and off the water.
insurancePages.features: ["Physical damage coverage for your boat","Liability protection on the water","Medical payments coverage","Uninsured watercraft coverage","Personal effects coverage","Emergency assistance & towing","Wreck removal coverage"]
insurancePages.tip: Many boat policies include discounts for completing boating safety courses.

insurancePages.title: ATV / Off-Road Insurance
insurancePages.tagline: Adventure protected, on and off the trail
insurancePages.description: ATVs, UTVs, and off-road vehicles need specialized insurance. Whether you're hitting the trails or working the land, Suzanne can get you covered for the unexpected.
insurancePages.features: ["Collision and comprehensive coverage","Liability protection","Uninsured motorist coverage","Custom parts and accessories coverage","Medical payments","Trailer coverage","Multiple vehicle discounts"]
insurancePages.tip: Some homeowners policies offer limited ATV coverage — but a dedicated policy provides full protection.

insurancePages.title: Flood Insurance
insurancePages.tagline: Standard policies don't cover floods — we do
insurancePages.description: Flooding is the most common and costly natural disaster in the U.S. — and it's not covered by standard homeowners insurance. Suzanne can help you get the flood protection you need through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP).
insurancePages.features: ["Building property coverage up to $250,000","Personal property coverage up to $100,000","Coverage for flood damage to your home's structure","Protection for furnace, water heater, and appliances","Coverage for debris removal","NFIP-backed policies","Preferred risk policies for low-to-moderate risk areas"]
insurancePages.tip: There's typically a 30-day waiting period before a new flood policy takes effect — don't wait for storm season!

insurancePages.title: Identity Protection
insurancePages.description: Identity theft can happen to anyone. Dwyer Insurance Group Identity Protection monitors your personal information and helps you recover if your identity is compromised. Get proactive monitoring and expert restoration support.
insurancePages.features: ["Dark web monitoring for your personal information","Social media account monitoring","Credit monitoring and alerts","Identity theft insurance up to $1 million","Dedicated restoration specialists","Lost wallet protection","Financial account takeover monitoring"]
insurancePages.tip: Over 14 million Americans were victims of identity theft last year — protect yourself proactively.

insurancePages.title: Roadside Assistance
insurancePages.description: Never get stranded again. Dwyer Insurance Group Roadside Assistance provides 24/7 help for common roadside emergencies, from flat tires and dead batteries to lockouts and towing. Available as an add-on to your auto policy or as a standalone plan.
insurancePages.features: ["Towing service up to your coverage limit","Jump-starts for dead batteries","Flat tire changes","Lockout service","Fuel delivery","24/7 nationwide coverage","No deductible or copay"]
insurancePages.tip: Good Hands Rescue® lets you request help with just a tap in the Allstate mobile app.

faqItems.question: Can I text your agency with questions?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We have text messaging services available. You can reach us at (610) 725-8137 for quick questions, policy updates, or to schedule an appointment.

faqItems.question: What languages do you speak?
faqItems.answer: We have staff members available who speak English and Spanish. We're committed to serving our diverse community in their preferred language.

faqItems.question: What states are you licensed in?
faqItems.answer: Suzanne Dwyer is insurance licensed in Delaware, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. If you reside outside these states, we can help connect you with another Allstate agent.

faqItems.question: How can I save money on my insurance?
faqItems.answer: We offer multiple discounts including multi-policy bundling (save up to 25%), safe driver discounts, claim-free discounts, good student discounts, and more. Contact us for a personalized quote and savings review.

faqItems.question: Do you offer virtual appointments?
faqItems.answer: Yes! We offer both in-person and virtual appointments for your convenience. Schedule an appointment that works for you — evenings and weekends available by request.

faqItems.question: What happens after I file a claim?
faqItems.answer: Once you file a claim, you'll be assigned a dedicated claims adjuster who will guide you through the process. Allstate's Claim Satisfaction Guarantee ensures you're happy with the outcome, or we'll make it right.

faqItems.question: How do I know if I need flood insurance?
faqItems.answer: Flood damage is not covered by standard homeowners insurance. If you live in a flood zone or near water, flood insurance is essential. Even in low-risk areas, about 25% of flood claims come from outside high-risk zones. We can assess your risk and help you decide.

faqItems.question: Can I bundle different types of insurance?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely! Bundling your policies (like auto + home) with Allstate can save you up to 25% on your premiums. We also offer multi-car discounts, safe driving bonuses, and loyalty rewards.
